name: decision-memo-drafter
description: Generate a concise, structured decision memo covering the decision to be made, options, tradeoffs, recommendation, risks, and open questions. Use for organizational decisions, research direction choices, procurement, or any situation requiring a structured written recommendation. Triggers on: "write a decision memo", "draft a recommendation", "help me decide", "structure this decision", "options analysis", "I need to recommend", "decision brief", "pros and cons structured".
